officialAvailability.evidence: 新品武将 赵忠 (查看原图) 势力 体力 性别 武将特点 群 3 男 可以分配强势技能给队友。关注场上的连环状态，可以为技能创造更大收益。 技能 【朋比】：你首个回合开始时，你选择获得“隐天”“蔽日”中的一个技能，然后可令一名其他角色获得另一个技能。 *【隐天】：锁定技，每回合首次有角色回复体力后，你下次造成的伤害+1（无法叠加）。 *【蔽日】：锁定技，每回合首次有角色不因摸牌获得牌后，你摸一张牌。 【抵慈】：出牌阶段限一次，你可以令一名角色交给你一张手牌，然后其回复1点体力并解除连环状态，其相邻角色进入连环状态。“抵慈”角色下次进入连环状态后，其选择：1.交给你一张手牌；2.你对其造成1点雷电伤害。 获取 2025-7-26 00:15:00~2025-8-2 24:00:00，商城直购活动获得。

editionExclusions.evidence: 新品武将 画师：MUMU 势力 体力 性别 称号 扩展包 出现模式 定位 群 6 男 骄纵窃幸 戚宦之争 身份模式、欢乐成双 控制、爆发 生平 赵忠（？—189年），安平人，东汉末年宦官，赵延之兄。桓帝、灵帝时，历为小黄门、中常侍、大长秋、车骑将军等职，封都乡侯。在职时以搜刮暴敛、骄纵贪婪见称，灵帝极为宠信，常谓“赵常侍是我母”。中平六年（189年），何进谋诛宦官，事泄，他和其余几个常侍设计伏杀何进，袁绍、袁术等人闻何进被杀，入宫杀尽宦官，后捕杀赵忠。 技能 【殃众】当你造成伤害后，你可以弃置两张牌，然后受伤角色失去1点体力；当你受到伤害后，伤害来源可以弃置两张牌，然后你失去1点体力。 【惶恐】锁定技，你的回合外，当你成为【杀】或伤害类锦囊牌的唯一目标后，若你没有手牌，你摸两张牌。 获得方式： 1、本期新品武将赵忠，可通过充值活动领取。 2、参与谷雨热力活动，全民热力值达到600W后可领取。 3、参与每日活跃/商城购买获得赵忠宝箱，有概率直接 获得。
editionExclusions.conclusion: This is a different product and rule set. Its six-HP identity, skills, equipment art or acquisition evidence must not replace ordinary OL hero 702.

documentedDifferences.currentClientEvidence: DiCi ddi sets targetCanBeSelf=false and uses oYt. oYt calls base Zf, which rejects a self seat when TargetCanBeSelf is false, then checks at least one NORMAL Hand card.
documentedDifferences.conclusion: The actual current frontend restricts initial Dici to another living role with a Hand card. The official prose does not explicitly say other. Preserve both facts; adopting the current UI restriction is an implementation interpretation, not a quoted FAQ.
documentedDifferences.runtimeDecision: Adopt current frontend admission: another living role with a true Hand card. Menu, AI and submission share the same target policy; empty-Hand forged input is rejected without spending quota.

documentedDifferences.currentClientEvidence: ddi.UpdateRoleDataResponse clears DATA_DICI for all seats, then marks each seat in the server-supplied list as 1.
documentedDifferences.conclusion: This only proves a boolean visual mark per target. It does not prove replacement, merged or stacked server obligations.
documentedDifferences.runtimeDecision: Freeze the living native seat neighbors after recovery/unlink children have drained. Each activation has an independent lease with original issuer, recipient, source instance, hash and issuance ordinal; settle due leases in issuance order across issuers. Same-issuer overlap in two actual Play phases of one turn is exercised. This is an explicit implementation contract: the listed official text and boolean frontend mark do not independently adjudicate multi-issuer stacking or its order.

implementationInterpretations.text: Pengbi is tied to this general's first actual turn that genuinely reaches the native TurnStartBeforeNormalFlow start window, including a genuine extra turn if it is the first such turn. The engine emits its internal TurnStartedEvent before checking face-down state; that scheduling event alone is not the rule's start timing. A face-down scheduled turn flips up and skips before the normal start window, so it neither executes Pengbi nor consumes the first normal-start opportunity. Native Preparation entries are grouped by distinct actual turn and owner to identify the first normal start without treating an inserted Play phase as a new turn. A new round alone, setup or loss/regrant does not create another first-own-turn entitlement, and acquiring Pengbi after an earlier normal own start does not create a retroactive first start. This is an implementation interpretation of the literal skill and this project's native timing contract, supported by the official-site-hosted community terminology article rather than an official ruling or dedicated Pengbi FAQ. The source has no duration for a granted derived skill; it is not made turn-limited.
implementationInterpretations.runtimeDecision: Implemented and exercised both permanent-grant directions, optional skip, real SkillsChanged child, source loss/regrant, first extra turn and face-down first scheduled-turn skip. No second entitlement is created by an inserted phase or later own start.

implementationInterpretations.text: Capture the genuine first positive recovery and actual non-draw Hand acquisition even when no holder exists. Freeze the holders at the producer; later acquisition cannot retroclaim a second event in that actual turn.
Only positive native Recovery changes qualify; a full-HP zero result does not. Dici still completes its unlink and neighbor effects after a zero result.

Keep at most one issued charge per owner across turns and source loss. Consume only on positive native DamageAppliedEvent; prevented zero damage retains it. Use the common native Card/Program/Judgment damage finalizer with original-source transfer identity. An increment on the first chained target is inherited normally; a new charge on a later chained target is locally rebased before the next recipient. Representative physical Slash, sequential Program instructions with an initially prevented attempt, transfer and three-target chain are exercised; no dedicated Judgment scenario is claimed.

Use a unique validated native draw invoice plus its physical materials and exact sequence interval. A chosen DrawPile obtain and Zenrun replacement Hand gain qualify as non-draw gains; their genuine compensation draws do not. Equipment placement is not a Hand gain. The issued native Draw1 and its actual replacement outcomes drain through their typed owner.

Publish and revalidate only another living donor with a true Hand card using the shared operation legality policy. The donor chooses its own physical entity privately. Drain the gift, Recovery1, unlink and each native neighbor-state child in order; positive recovery is not a prerequisite.

Issue each delayed obligation only after the initial Dici effects finish. It waits for the marked target's next actual false-to-true chained transition, with no turn-end expiration. Source loss does not revoke it; a started lease is consumed once and cannot be retriggered by a later entry or an already-true no-op.

Freeze the living native seat neighbors after recovery/unlink children have drained. Each activation has an independent lease with original issuer, recipient, source instance, hash and issuance ordinal; settle due leases in issuance order across issuers. Same-issuer overlap in two actual Play phases of one turn is exercised. This is an explicit implementation contract: the listed official text and boolean frontend mark do not independently adjudicate multi-issuer stacking or its order.

Paid children continue exactly once across loss and cold restore. Issuer death preserves an already-issued obligation and the original source of its native thunder damage; a dead issuer cannot receive a new gift. Marked-target death cancels an unstarted obligation. Representative actual issuer death, target death and conditional-HP source loss are exercised.

focusedBehaviorGroups.name: PengbiFirstActualTurnAndDerivedGrants
behaviors: Both skill-selection directions and optional other-recipient cancellation.
Actual first turn versus inserted phase/extra turn, skill loss/regrant and exactly-once grant.
Cold restore before selection, after own grant and before optional recipient grant; no duplicate skill-source instance.

focusedBehaviorGroups.name: YintianFirstRecoveryAndNonstackingNextDamage
behaviors: First real positive recovery by any role; zero actual recovery and later recovery in the same actual turn are negative boundaries.
Pending +1 survives a turn return, cannot stack, then applies to exactly one native damage event.
Representative prevented/changed damage and paid loss/death cold boundary chosen after root fixes the consumption contract.

focusedBehaviorGroups.name: BiriGenuineGainVersusDraw
behaviors: Actual draw including recast draw does not trigger; a real foreign Hand gift does.
A selected DrawPile obtain and a draw replacement remain distinguished by structured native proof.
Only one first gain per actual turn, own Draw1 does not recurse, and Cold during the issued draw/recovery children.

focusedBehaviorGroups.name: DiciHandGiftAndNextChainLease
behaviors: Real donor-selected Hand payment and invalid self/empty-Hand/equipment-cost rejection according to the current UI contract.
Recover then unlink then link living neighbors; preserve every native Lion/Ox, HP and chained-damage child that actually occurs.
Next real unchained-to-chained transition offers donor Hand1 versus thunder1; no retrigger from an already-chained no-op.
Representative issuer source-loss/death and target death/cold behavior; exercise overlap only after the explicit root decision.
